br-world-vale-dos-vinhedos.basis: Recognised by INPI (Lei 9.279/1996). The specifications delimit the area by maps; the outline is the municipalities it touches.
br-world-vale-dos-vinhedos.outline: Shown as a point at the place it is named after. The registered area is much smaller than any administrative unit, and its boundary is not yet available as open data.
br-world-vale-dos-vinhedos.atlas_note: Valley in the Serra Gaúcha of Rio Grande do Sul, settled by Italian immigrants in the 1870s. Brazil's first wine IP (2002) and first DO (2012).
